svg.title: Testate. Git for your test database.
svg.desc: Snapshot the databases behind a system under test, break them, put them back in seconds. A field of rows takes a state, a test run turns a third of them amber, a checkout sweeps across and every row returns. Beside it stands the states timeline with HEAD lit.
